description: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) using TOTP with QR codes. Mandatory for admins, optional for tutors. Students and parents are exempt. Package: pragmarx/google2fa-laravel. Hooks into LoginController post-password-success. Settings UI for enable/disable, QR code display, and recovery codes management.
steps: 1. Install composer package: composer require pragmarx/google2fa-laravel. This package wraps pragmarx/google2fa and includes QR code generation via bacon/bacon-qr-code.

2. Create migration 2026_10_31_000001_create_two_factor_auth_table.php with Schema::create('two_factor_auth', ...) containing: id, user_id (FK to users, unique), secret (encrypted string), recovery_codes (json, encrypted), enabled_at (nullable timestamp), timestamps. Use $table->foreign('user_id')->references('id')->on('users')->onDelete('cascade').

3. Create model app/Models/TwoFactorAuth.php with fillable ['user_id','secret','recovery_codes','enabled_at'], casts ['recovery_codes'=>'array','enabled_at'=>'datetime'], and protected $encryptable = ['secret','recovery_codes'] (Laravel auto-encrypts these). Relationship: belongsTo(User::class).

4. Add relationship to app/Models/User.php: public function twoFactorAuth() { return $this->hasOne(TwoFactorAuth::class); }. Add helper: public function has2FAEnabled(): bool { return $this->twoFactorAuth && $this->twoFactorAuth->enabled_at !== null; }

5. Modify app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.php store() method: after successful Auth::attempt() and is_active check, add 2FA redirect logic. If user is admin or tutor AND has 2FA enabled, store user_id in session as '2fa_user_id', logout the user (Auth::logout()), and redirect to route('2fa.challenge'). Otherwise proceed to dashboard as normal. For admins without 2FA, redirect to route('2fa.setup.force') instead of dashboard.

6. Create app/Http/Controllers/Auth/TwoFactorController.php with methods: showSetup() [GET /2fa/setup], storeSetup(Request) [POST /2fa/setup - generates secret, QR, recovery codes, stores in DB, marks enabled_at], showChallenge() [GET /2fa/challenge - shows code input form], verifyChallenge(Request) [POST /2fa/challenge - verifies TOTP or recovery code, logs user in on success], disable(Request) [POST /2fa/disable - requires password confirmation, deletes 2FA record]. Use PragmaRX\Google2FALaravel\Facade\Google2FA for TOTP operations.

7. Add routes to routes/web.php: Route::middleware('guest')->group: GET/POST /2fa/setup, GET/POST /2fa/challenge. Route::middleware('auth')->group: POST /2fa/disable, POST /2fa/recovery (regenerate recovery codes). Route /2fa/setup/force for admins (middleware guest or auth, check inside controller).

8. Create Blade views: resources/views/auth/2fa-setup.blade.php (shows QR code via data:image/svg+xml URL from Google2FA::getQRCodeInline(), lists 8 recovery codes, copy buttons, continue button), resources/views/auth/2fa-challenge.blade.php (6-digit code input, use recovery code link, back to login link), resources/views/auth/2fa-force.blade.php (admin-only first-time setup mandate). Match existing auth view styles with card-based layout and DM Sans font.

9. Create settings tab in resources/views/pages/settings/security.blade.php (new file, or add to existing settings page if one exists for users). Show 2FA status badge, Enable/Disable toggle button (POST to /2fa/setup or /2fa/disable), view recovery codes button (modal or inline), regenerate recovery codes button. Only show for tutors and admins. Use card component with inline CSS matching admin/settings.blade.php pattern.

10. Create app/Notifications/TwoFactorEnabledNotification.php extending Notification, via(['mail']), toMail() returns MailMessage with subject 'Two-Factor Authentication Enabled' and plain text body confirming 2FA is now active for the account. Send this notification in storeSetup() after enabling 2FA.
acceptance_criteria: After password login, admins and tutors with 2FA enabled are redirected to /2fa/challenge before dashboard access
Admins without 2FA are forced to /2fa/setup on first login
QR code displays correctly in setup flow and can be scanned by Google Authenticator or Authy
6-digit TOTP codes verify successfully within the 30-second window
Recovery codes (8 codes) can be used as fallback and are consumed on use
Disabling 2FA requires password re-confirmation and removes the two_factor_auth record
Students and parents never see 2FA prompts or settings
Email notification sent when 2FA is enabled
verification: Run php artisan migrate to create two_factor_auth table
Register as admin and login - should be redirected to /2fa/setup (forced)
Scan QR code with authenticator app, enter 6-digit code, verify redirect to dashboard
Logout and login again - should go to /2fa/challenge, enter code, verify login succeeds
Visit settings page as admin, verify 2FA shows as enabled with recovery codes visible
Disable 2FA, logout, login again - should go directly to dashboard (no challenge)
Register as tutor, enable 2FA from settings, logout, login, verify challenge page appears
Register as student, verify no 2FA options appear in settings or login flow
Check storage/logs/laravel.log for any errors during the flow
